errors.description: Two records state facts that cannot both be true (a person alive and dead, an object in two places, a place open and locked at one time).
A record states something as established that no earlier record, character sheet or the player's input gives a basis for.
The order or timing of records is impossible (something is reacted to before it happens).
A character acts on something it never perceived (it has no perception of the event, and nobody told it).
A character fails to use or contradicts something it plainly perceived shortly before and that bears on the moment.

dimensions.label: Fidelity to who a character is

errors.description: A character acts against its personality, speech style or situation without a reason in the story.
A record gives the player's character thoughts, words or decisions the player did not provide.
Records repeat the same beat, phrase or reaction without anything new happening.
